chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Harry White hires Danny for the Nest Club
summary: Two weeks after arriving, Danny was hired by trombonist Harry White, a former Ellington man, introduced by Uncle Paul.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: The second week I was in New York, a guy approached me who had been...my Uncle Paul had introduced me to. His name was Harry White.

Yes, Paul Barbarin. This guy's name was Harry White. He had been one of the original trombone players with Duke Ellington. He'd come out of Washington. He was a member of the White Brothers Band. Eddie and three
And they called him Father White, didn't they.
Yeah, Father White. So he came to me and said, 'Are you working?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Do you want to go with me to the Nest Club? I've got a job.' I said, 'Yeah.' He said, 'Okay.'

So I started two weeks after I got to New York with Harry White in the Nest Club. A six-piece band. We go to work at ten o'clock. You might tune up until eleven, or fool around, because it was somewhat of an after-hour joint. It was a famous...
